thread:
elaine: Quick question — as we roll out the per-route / per-model saved filters, how do we want 'routing hints' surfaced in the Console? Do we bake them into the saved view or keep them separate?

raj: my vote: include lightweight routing hints in the saved view metadata. that keeps UX simple for product teams — they see 'preferred region' / 'preferred tier' with a view. fallbacks can live in policy config.

ben: worried about coupling. saved views are user-level objects; routing policies live on infra. if we copy routing hints into views we need a sync strategy or we'll get drift.

tia: could be a read-only display in the view UI with a link to the routing policy. show 'effective routing' vs 'view suggestion'. :link:

elaine: agree with tia. display the hint but mark it as suggestion. backend question: do we store the suggestion in the saved-query row or compute it on read from a policy service?

ben: compute on read is my preference. smaller DB footprint and single source of truth for policies. but we should cache the resolved hint in the view for faster rendering and offline consistency (eg. when policy service is down).

raj: caching requires a TTL and clear invalidation on policy change. we can store a small blob on the saved view: {"hint_source": "policy_service_v1", "cached_hint": "region:us-east1,tier:dedicated", "cached_at": 1700000000}. show stale indicator in UI.

elaine: that JSON shape looks fine. Ben — what telemetry should we emit so product can evaluate rollout outcomes (latency, cost delta, fallback rate)?

ben: minimal payload: view_id, route_id, model_id, resolved_hint, fallback_reason (if any), tokens_burned, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, cost_estimate_usd, experiment_tag. keep under 1KB per event.

raj: +1. also capture whether the hint was honored or overridden, and the policy version. helps debug divergence.

console-bot: NOTE: new schema agreed: saved view will carry cached_hint + hint_source + cached_at. an event "view_resolved_routing" will include the telemetry fields ben listed.

tia: UX: in the view header show a small badge "Routing: suggestion (us-east1)" and a hover card that explains why and links to policy. add a blue 'apply' button for workspace admins to lock that hint as policy override.

elaine: locking from UI is sensitive — need auth controls and audit log. we should create an API endpoint: POST /api/views/:id/lock-routing with body {"policy_action":"apply_hint","policy_id":"..."}. returns 202 and a task id.

ben: implementation note: the endpoint should validate that the hint is compatible with the policy schema (region, tier, model-compatibility). return clear error codes for incompatible hints.

raj: small API contract sketch:
```
POST /api/views/:id/lock-routing
{
  "action": "apply_hint",
  "hint": {"region":"us-east1","tier":"dedicated"},
  "requester": "elaine"
}

200 OK -> {"status":"applied","policy_id":"pol_123","applied_at":1700001234}
409 Conflict -> {"error":"incompatible_hint","details":"model not allowed on dedicated tier"}
```

tia: also think about rollout UX: show a rollout card when a saved view is published to org: "This view suggests routing changes — measure impact on 10% traffic for 48h" with quick toggle.

elaine: good. responsibility matrix: product owns the UI copy and rollout card, infra owns policy service & events, backend owns caching and lock endpoint.

ben: one more telemetry ask — emit a 'view_hint_diff' event when the cached_hint vs policy_resolved differ after a policy change. helps detect drift.

raj: yep. and we should add an alert rule in Console Optimize: if fallback_rate > 5% for a view during rollout, auto-rollback suggestion.

elaine: action items: 1) ben to spec telemetry events + size budget (ETA end of week). 2) raj to draft cache TTL + invalidation signaller (ETA Tue). 3) tia to mock UI badges/rollout card (ETA Wed). 4) infra to add policy version in resolved responses (ping infra).

ben: I'll put telemetry proto in #eng-telemetry and paste sample events.

elaine: thanks all — this unblocks the saved-views routing affordance. any objections?

raj: no objections. :thumbsup:

console-bot: ACTION CREATED: telemetry-spec (ben) | cache-ttl (raj) | ui-mock (tia) | infra-policy-version (infra-team).
